name: TC-20-preventive-maintenance-scenario
description: TC-20.2: Preventive Maintenance End-to-End Scenario — PM Calendar → Activity → WO → Completion

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.2 — Step 1: PM Calendar
doc_metadata.caption: The preventive maintenance scenario starts with the PM Calendar. Scheduled tasks are displayed in a monthly view with color-coded statuses.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.2 — PM Calendar Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The calendar shows all scheduled preventive maintenance tasks. Creating a task auto-generates the chain: Maintenance Activity → PMA → Work Order (Preventive) → WO Activity → Maintenance Request.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.2 — Step 2: Maintenance Activity
doc_metadata.caption: Maintenance activities are generated from PM Calendar tasks. Each activity links to a PMA template and a work order.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.2 — Maintenance Activities
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance activity list shows scheduled PM tasks with their status, due date, and linked entities (PMA, WO, MR). Activities progress through Draft → Pending → Approved → Release → Completed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.2 — Step 3: Preventive Work Order
doc_metadata.caption: Work orders generated from PM Calendar tasks have type 'Preventive'. They inherit the task details, assigned resources, and checklists from the PMA template.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.2 — Preventive WO Execution
doc_metadata.caption: The preventive work order tracks the scheduled maintenance execution. Completing the WO updates the PM Calendar and resets the schedule for the next occurrence.
